correctness.rationale: PASS. The coefficient-extraction bilinear pairing has determinant ±1, proving equivalence of recurrence period with order of x in the rank-k quotient ring. Modulo 2 the order is exactly k+1; the identity (x−1)P=x^(k+1)−2x^k+1 gives x^(k+1)=1+2u. Since u and u(u+1) are nonzero modulo 2, exact coefficientwise valuations of successive squares imply order 2^(r−1) at every r. These steps prove the result for all k≥2 and r≥1; 232 independent finite state tests and ring computations corroborate but do not establish the theorem.
